integrity.computational_checks: Standalone standard-library exact permutation enumeration for K_{2,2}, K_{2,3}, K_{2,4} and boundary K_{3,3}.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact spanning-tree enumeration, deterministic minimization and a symmetry/independence argument.
integrity.unproved_extension: No graph-classification theorem or K_{m,n} equality for m,n at least 3 is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The graph is the complete bipartite K_{2,n} with integer n at least 2; the result is not claimed for general bicliques or general graphs.
Edge weights are mutually independent with one common atomless probability distribution; no assertion for heterogeneous or dependent weights.
The full law is proved analytically; finite enumerations are supplementary exact checks, not proofs of the infinite parameter range.
Priority remains conditional on the cited and searched literature; prior unindexed general matroid theorems may exist.
title: Uniform random minimum spanning trees on two-hub complete bipartite graphs
